training.start: Continue each matched arm's last checkpoint at epoch 8, including Adam state and TRAIN shuffle RNG

protocol.stopping: Use only validation accuracy for stopping. Earliest eligible common epoch with all 12 runs passing all three thresholds; otherwise continue every arm to the next common checkpoint or cap. At the cap identify runs that did not meet the plateau rule. Record tail validation CE for interpretation.
protocol.selection: Highest original VAL correct count across the actual trajectory including archived epochs 1-8, then lowest VAL CE, then earliest epoch
protocol.interpretation: Stability of recent validation accuracy within stated tolerances under this optimizer and budget. Test accuracy and training loss do not decide stopping or checkpoint selection.

summary.selected_checkpoint_summary_basis: Both fields above use each run’s best VAL checkpoint.

common_endpoint.method: Full-split accuracies observed at the final common epoch. Tail TEST averages use all ten observed end-of-epoch accuracies with equal weight; seeds have equal weight. These diagnostics use the same held images repeatedly and do not select the checkpoint or stopping epoch.

summary.selected_checkpoint_summary_basis: Both fields above use each run’s best VAL checkpoint.

common_endpoint.method: Full-split accuracies observed at the final common epoch. Tail TEST averages use all ten observed end-of-epoch accuracies with equal weight; seeds have equal weight. These diagnostics use the same held images repeatedly and do not select the checkpoint or stopping epoch.

epoch_evidence: VAL and online training loss are from the original trajectory throughout. E1–8 dotted TRAIN/TEST curves are companion-replay diagnostics. Direct original checkpoint evaluations are labeled per epoch. E8 dots anchor measured E9+ full-split end-of-epoch curves.
selection: Best VAL correct count, then minimum VAL cross entropy, then earliest exact tie.
